channel.title: So What? by Brandmizer
channel.description: Marketing news for Indian business owners, with what it means for you.

item.title: Google Makes Gemini 4 Hydrogen The Default Model In AI Mode
item.description: For you: Google's AI answers now handle more searches before anyone clicks a link. Make sure your Google Business Profile, website and menu or price pages say plainly what you sell, where you are and who it's for, so the answer can name you. (Source: Search Engine Journal)

item.title: How to Submit Your Website to ChatGPT Business Hub
item.description: For you: People now ask ChatGPT where to eat or which clinic to visit. Claim your business in ChatGPT's Business Hub, verify your website, and make sure the name, address and phone match your Google profile exactly. (Source: Search Engine Journal)

item.title: We’re introducing a new transparency tool for invalid traffic in Google Ads.
item.description: For you: Open your Google Ads account this week and look at the new invalid-traffic view. If you run local search ads, it shows clicks you were charged for that weren't real customers, and the credits Google gave back. (Source: Google Ads & Commerce)

item.title: Wedding influencer rate cards see a 20–25% surge as brands spend ₹50 lakh+ on campaigns
item.description: For you: If you sell bridal wear, makeup, jewellery or a venue, wedding-season creators are getting more expensive. Book the ones your customers actually follow now, and ask for a package of reels and stories instead of a single post. (Source: Social Samosa)

item.title: Google’s November 2026 Core Update Starts Rolling Out
item.description: For you: Expect search rankings to move over the next two weeks, so avoid panic edits. Note your website's top pages and Google Business Profile views now, compare after the rollout ends, and improve pages that lost ground with clearer, genuinely useful content. (Source: Search Engine Journal)

item.title: From measurement to capital allocation: How leaders are putting incrementality to work
item.description: For you: Before raising ad budgets, ask which sales truly came from the ad. Run a simple test: pause ads in one area or week, or add a unique offer code, and compare walk-ins or enquiries to see what the spend adds. (Source: Meta for Business)

item.title: Finding His Squad Again in a Facebook Group
item.description: For you: Meta is pushing AI help for small businesses. If you post on Facebook or Instagram yourself, look in your Meta Business tools for AI assistants that draft posts or replies, and try one on a routine task like a weekly offer post. (Source: Meta for Business)

item.title: ACKO puts 80% of media spend into creators and CTV
item.description: For you: Large Indian brands are moving most of their spend to creators. You can test the same idea on a small budget: two or three local creators your customers already watch, posting about you every month, then compare the enquiries. (Source: afaqs)

item.title: Navigating the regulatory maze of influencer marketing
item.description: For you: If you pay or gift creators, make sure every post is clearly marked as paid or gifted in the caption and on the video. Ask creators to keep claims honest, especially for skin, health and money products. (Source: afaqs)

item.title: Visits To The Top Million Websites Fell 12%, Data Shows
item.description: For you: Fewer people click through to websites now, so more of your selling happens before the visit. Keep your Google profile, Instagram bio and WhatsApp catalogue as sharp as your website, because that's often where the decision gets made. (Source: Search Engine Journal)

item.title: New Google Help Doc Explains How To Identifying Traffic From Google Search
item.description: For you: Ask whoever runs your website to read Google's new guide and set up a clear 'from Google Search' view in your analytics. You can't judge whether SEO is working until you can see those visits on their own. (Source: Search Engine Roundtable)

item.title: NPCI Unveils New MDR-Funded Scheme To Promote UPI Among Small Merchants
item.description: For you: If you still take payments on a personal UPI ID, ask your bank about this new scheme for small merchants. A proper business QR at the counter keeps shop money separate and looks more trustworthy to new customers. (Source: Inc42)

item.title: Google Ads Disallows Impersonate Public Figures With AI Even If Disclosed
item.description: For you: Using an AI-made version of a celebrity or local influencer in your Google ads is not allowed, even if you label it as AI. Use real people who have agreed to appear: your team, your customers, or a creator you've paid. (Source: Search Engine Roundtable)

item.title: AI Shopping Errors: What To Fix To Help Shoppers Choose Your Products
item.description: For you: If you sell online, AI shopping assistants now read your product pages. Write full, accurate titles, sizes, materials and prices, and fix pages where any of these are missing; that is what lets an assistant recommend you. (Source: Search Engine Journal)

item.title: FMCG ad spends diverge as companies recalibrate investments amid rising costs and digital disruption
item.description: For you: Big FMCG brands are moving ad money to digital and quick-commerce apps. If you make a packaged product, check whether your category sells on quick-commerce apps in your city; being listed there may matter more than another print ad. (Source: ET BrandEquity)
